entries.message: is an alertdialog with no autofocus, so focus lands on its first focusable element, which may be the destructive action.
entries.fix: Put autofocus on the least destructive button, such as Cancel.

entries.message: is an alertdialog with no description, so a screen reader announces its title but not the message it asks about.
entries.fix: Mark the message data-vera-part="description", or give the <dialog> an aria-describedby.

entries.message: has no direct child <dialog>, so there is nothing to open: the element wires the author's own <dialog> and renders none.
entries.fix: Put a <dialog> inside it, as its direct child.

entries.message: has a dialog with no aria-label, no aria-labelledby and no heading, so a screen reader announces an unnamed dialog.
entries.fix: Start the dialog with a heading (it becomes the name), or give the <dialog> an aria-label.
